title: Ultra-photorealistic vertical 9:16 candid live sports broadcast still shot…
content: Ultra-photorealistic vertical 9:16 candid live sports broadcast still shot inside a packed football stadium during a major tournament. A young attractive female fan wearing a red Portugal national team jersey with the number 4 visible, sitting in the crowd. She has long dark brown hair with loose strands, a small Portugal flag decal on her cheek, natural skin texture with subtle imperfections, and a focused, slightly pensive expression as she looks toward the field. She is wearing gold hoop earrings, a delicate necklace, and beaded bracelets. The background is a soft-focus (bokeh) view of a crowded stadium, filled with other fans in green and red attire, captured with a professional broadcast telephoto lens to create depth compression.
